description: Calculate the current Vimshottari mahadasha and a bounded timeline of planetary periods from supplied birth data, the starting point for career and relationship timing questions. Includes current antardasha and pratyantardasha. Optional from_date/to_date (YYYY-MM-DD) return overlapping sub-periods with full boundaries in an end-exclusive range of at most 1096 days; from_date alone defaults to 90 days. Depth must be between 1 and 20. Use city, region and country for a place. If a place is not found, ask the user to clarify it before trying another tool with the same place. Use only verified latitude and longitude; never guess coordinates.

date.description: Local birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Ask the user if it is unclear; do not infer it.

latitude.description: Verified latitude from -90 to 90, supplied with longitude. Never guess coordinates.

longitude.description: Verified longitude from -180 to 180, supplied with latitude. Never guess coordinates.

place.description: Birth city, region and country. Ask for clarification if unresolved before retrying in any tool. Do not silently substitute a different location.

time.description: Local birth time in 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format, without a UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, or omit to derive it from the verified birth location.

name: get_dasha_timeline
title: Calculate a Vimshottari dasha timeline
